officialTariff.note: Official values are tied to the SWK Ladekarte and are not promoted to contract-free ad-hoc.

stationDiscoveryEvidence.note: GoingElectric currently reports 0.60 EUR/kWh on multiple SWK/ladenetz AC EVSEs and 0.60-0.67 EUR/kWh at a mixed AC/HPC SWK site. This is discovery evidence only.

reason: The official SWK surface publishes current Ladekarte prices but does not expose a current universal numeric ad-hoc tariff. Station-level aggregator observations are not generalized to the CPO network.
nextEvidenceNeeded: Official direct-payment/QR checkout or station API payload tying the ad-hoc amount and any blocking component to SWK EVSEs.
